text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome. The patient's presentation of significant weight loss, fatigue, and bilateral lower leg swelling, combined with lab results showing heavy proteinuria (4+), hypoalbuminemia (1.8 g/dL), and hyperlipidemia, is diagnostic for nephrotic syndrome. While his history of chronic bronchitis is noted, the clinical picture strongly supports a primary kidney disorder rather than an infection.
